question: Which prepared sesame-oil anointing is said to make the penis thick?
premises: That cooked preparation is an anointing.
The anointing makes the penis thick.
inference: The verse prescribes a sesame-oil preparation as an anointing that thickens the penis.
uncertainties: Exact application site and dosage are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Sesame cooked in oil—its anointing—makes the penis thick.
